svg.title: Blue Green Curve
svg.desc: Interpretive study after a visually inspected primary museum photograph. Approximate geometry; standardized vivid screen colours. Observed triangular outer canvas points left. Green lower field has an upward-curving top boundary; wall and cast shadow remain absent.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.moca.org/artworks/blue-green-curve; object 85.57; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
